item.title: [IGNITE-13227] AssertionError on getting cache size from the mbean on the inactive cluster
item.description:
The reproducer for CacheMetricsManageTest:

    /** @throws Exception If failed. */
    @Test
    public void testCacheSize() throws Exception {
        persistence = true;

        startGrid(0);

        CacheMetricsMXBean mxBean = mxBean(0, CACHE1, CacheClusterMetricsMXBeanImpl.class);

        long size = mxBean.getCacheSize();

        assertEquals(0, size);
    }
